topic: What if you were trapped in a video game?
title: WHAT IF YOU WERE
TRAPPED IN A VIDEO GAME?

script.text: You respawn in a living room. Everything looks like a video game.
You jump on the couch. It bounces like a trampoline.
You pick up a cookie. It glows. +10 HP.
What if you were trapped in a video game?
You double-jump off the fridge. You pause time. You respawn after falling.
The NPCs repeat the same line. The world is made of blocks. There is no exit door.
A glitchy figure watches you from the corner. It does not blink.
Your sister is trapped in the loading screen. You must reach her before the timer hits zero.
The final boss loads. You have one life left. Part 1 of 2.

shots.line: You respawn in a living room. Everything looks like a video game.
shots.note: Mascot stands in a blocky living room at dusk

shots.line: You jump on the couch. It bounces like a trampoline.
You pick up a cookie. It glows. +10 HP.
shots.note: Close-up of a glowing cookie in the mascot's hand
The world freezes; mascot moves freely
Mascot falls and respawns at the start point

shots.line: The NPCs repeat the same line.
shots.note: A blocky NPC faces the mascot, mouth looping

shots.line: The world is made of blocks.
shots.note: The mascot's hand touches a blocky wall
The room has no doors or windows, only walls

shots.line: A glitchy figure watches you from the corner.
shots.note: A distorted figure stands in the corner
Extreme close-up of the glitchy figure's unblinking eye

shots.line: Your sister is trapped in the loading screen.
shots.note: A loading screen with the sister stuck inside

shots.line: You must reach her before the timer hits zero.
shots.note: A countdown timer ticks down beside the mascot
The screen fades to black on the cliffhanger
